subject.title: [Feature]: Move away from useMultiFileAuthState for Baileys

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin replace Baileys multi-file auth state now, and should the supported design be plugin-owned SQLite plus doctor migration rather than a generic SQL/Postgres surface?
rationale: The source and upstream dependency guidance support replacing the helper, but the change rewrites sensitive credential/session storage and needs a maintainer choice on permanent storage, migration, and security-proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor SQLite redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open as a maintainer-owned WhatsApp auth-store redesign using SQLite, plugin-owned doctor migration, and focused migration/security proof.

options.title: Defer replacement
options.body: Keep the hardened Baileys multi-file path for now and require a narrower live repro or design proposal before implementation work starts.

options.title: Decline core change
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the current Baileys helper plus existing hardening is the intended long-term WhatsApp auth boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor SQLite redesign
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as a maintainer-owned WhatsApp auth-store redesign using SQLite, plugin-owned doctor migration, and focused migration/security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged WhatsApp auth persistence work is the closest current-main ownership signal for the storage and migration boundary.
